max_tire.note: A Defender2.net owner runs it on a coil-sprung truck on stock 8.5 in 20s with no spacers and no rubbing; others warn it can touch on some setups. 275/55R20 clears on air at full articulation, and Australian owners run 275/65R18 LT on 18s. The OCTA fits 33s from the factory.
Lucky8's 110 build: Proud Rhino lift rods keeping air suspension, 18 in wheels, some lower bumper trimming, custom fender brackets, smaller rear calipers to clear the 18s and relocated intercoolers.

items.title: DC-DC converter overload can cut drive power (MHEV)
items.summary: Mild-hybrid DC-DC converters can fail under high electrical load, ending 12-volt charging and possibly drive power; software remedy, interim letters sent in 2026.

items.title: Driver airbag clockspring connector corrosion
items.summary: The connector can corrode so the airbag doesn't deploy as intended; dealers apply protective gel (Land Rover D120).

items.title: Engine cam carrier oil channel may be blocked
items.summary: A blocked channel can cause an oil leak and fire risk; dealers inspect and replace the cam carrier (Land Rover N763).

items.title: Oil filter housing can crack
items.summary: Oil can leak into the engine bay; dealers replace the housing, filter and O-rings (Land Rover N908).

items.title: PCM can switch off while driving (six-cylinder)
items.summary: Engine stall without warning; remedy disables Connected Diagnostic Services and OTA diagnostics.

items.title: Smoked rear lights can fail (Defender X)
items.summary: A voltage spike from bright light on the rear can kill turn, brake and tail lights; assemblies replaced (N598).

items.title: Raised air intake accessory may detach
items.summary: Dealer-fitted raised air intake VPLEP0543 may not be secured; inspect and reinstall (N964).

items.title: Fuel tank walls too thin
items.summary: An improperly made fuel tank may leak fuel in a crash, raising fire risk; dealers replace the tank (Land Rover D127).

items.title: Front seat belt pretensioners may be damaged
items.summary: Driver and passenger belts may not restrain properly; dealers inspect and replace the front belt assemblies as needed (N720).

items.title: TReK-modified 130: brake calipers may detach
items.summary: Defender 130s modified for the TReK competition may have calipers not reinstalled properly; dealers reinstall them (N848). Check this on any ex-TReK truck.

tsbs.title: E005 idler pulley campaign, 3.0 Ingenium diesel
tsbs.summary: UK campaign for 3.0 I6 diesels built from 1 March 2024 (diesels weren't sold in the US); confirm it's closed on any diesel truck.

timeline.change: Revealed at Frankfurt on 10 September; built at Nitra, Slovakia
110 deliveries begin; the 90 follows, offered in the US as a 3.0 six First Edition
3.0 six-cylinder MHEV diesels replace the 2.0 diesels (outside the US); P525 V8 joins
Three-row 130 on sale in the US; 500-unit 30th Anniversary Edition for North America
BMW-engined OCTA (P635, 6D Dynamics, 33-in tyres) revealed; D350 diesel added to the range around this time (timing varies by market)
Mild-hybrid trucks covered by DC-DC converter recalls; check the remedy is done
First major update, unveiled 28 May 2025: flush lights, revised front and rear aprons

identify.intro: The L663 has been sold in many engines, suspension setups and special editions, and the limited ones carry real premiums. Check what you're looking at.

items.head: Coil or air
items.body: Land Rover fits air to every 110 and 130. A 90 can be coil or air; coil 90s have about 225 mm clearance, wade 850 mm and have no height modes, while air trucks reach 291 mm at off-road height and wade 900 mm.

items.head: Engine
items.body: US trucks: P300 2.0 four on earlier trucks, P400 3.0 mild-hybrid six, P525 5.0 supercharged V8 and the OCTA's 4.4 twin-turbo V8 (EPA's 2026 list also shows a 130 P300 as a 3.0 six). D-badged diesels and the P400e plug-in weren't sold in the US.

items.head: 30th Anniversary Edition
items.body: 500 North American 110 P300s in Fuji White on white steel wheels, with the Expedition roof rack and side ladder. Every one wears the same 1/500 badge, so the badge doesn't tell you which number it is.

items.head: TReK trucks
items.body: Ex-competition Defenders from Land Rover's TReK event are sold through the participating retailers with their accessories; Wikipedia puts production at no more than 100 a year, with the number on the badging.

items.head: OCTA
items.body: 28 mm taller and 68 mm wider than a standard Defender, with octagon badging; Edition One trucks are Faroe Green.

capability.v: 370 lb dynamic (110/130), 260 lb (90); 661 lb (300 kg) static
capability.note: with off-road tyres and Expedition Roof Rack; V8s have no dynamic rating

capability.v: Air 216 mm std / 291 mm off-road (11.5 in); coil 225 mm (226 mm at off-road setting)

values.intro: Depreciation has made early trucks the bargains; low-mileage late 110s and special editions hold their money best.
values.note: Based on 15 Bring a Trailer sales in 2025–26 ($27,250–89,000, median $45,000); the two Carpathian Editions sold for $85,000 and $89,000.
